verdict.rationale: The docs say users can choose which actions need approval and that agents pause to ask for input. Users can follow agents live and interact through the dashboard or a first-party Slack connector. Community comments indicate a mobile app is used to drive agents from a phone (iOS only, per the Android complaint). Missing for 10: first-party docs tying the approval flow to mobile or push notifications, Android support, explicit evidence that other agents keep working while one waits for approval, and hands-on corroboration of approving from a phone.
